ev.q: During 2024 (through September 30), Afghanistan reported 23 WPV1 cases, the highest number in 4 years.
House-to-house vaccination coverage reached 90%–98% of children during June–July 2024.
The NPAFP rate in 2023 was 26 per 100,000 children aged <15 years (regional range = 17.0–39.1)
In 2023, WPV1 was detected in 62 ES samples from eight provinces in four regions
and stool specimen adequacy was 94% (regional range = 90.7%–97.0%)
estimated 2-dose IPV coverage was 45%, compared with 30% in 2021 and 43% in 2022
representing approximately four times the number of cases during all of 2023
This report describes immunization and surveillance activities and progress toward polio eradication in Afghanistan during January 2023–September 2024.
AFP and ES data, characteristics of patients with laboratory-confirmed poliomyelitis, and genomic sequence analysis of poliovirus isolates were reviewed and described.

methods_quotes.q: Vaccination activities, coverage data, and performance indicators were reviewed and tabulated by region and by vaccination modality.
Postcampaign surveys are conducted by independent, trained personnel who select households by purposive sampling
Vaccine dose histories reported by caregivers and collected during AFP investigations were reviewed and analyzed among children with confirmed WPV1 cases.
The expected background NPAFP rate is two or more cases per 100,000 children aged <15 years per year
